name: Hammered Gold Hoop Earrings
description: A matched pair of polished gold-tone hoop earrings with a subtle hammered texture and a hinge-snap post closure.
materials: Hammered gold-tone metal hoops with a polished post and hinge-snap closure
negativeConstraints: Never render more than two hoops or a mismatched pair, the two earrings must always be identical in size and diameter; never let the hammered texture read as deep, rough, or random; never add gemstones, dangling charms, or any text/engraving near the post or on the hoop. Exception: a mark, wordmark, or label that the brief's art direction explicitly names is deliberate and must be rendered exactly as directed — the text bans above apply only to invented marks the art direction never asked for.
preservationNotes: Keep the hoop diameter, wire gauge, and hammered-texture pattern identical between both earrings of the pair across every angle; keep the post and hinge closure plain, blank, unmarked metal in every shot. When the art direction explicitly names a mark on this product, that named mark is part of the product's identity for that shot and overrides the blank-surface requirement.
